## Purpose 
Adding box model and a 2D setup. Kimeatic1D model and CalibrateCMP are changed into submodules.


## To-do
Generalizing calibrations for any arbitrary system is left for future PRs upon need. Now, calibrations are possible only in the 1D setup.
